% {\footnotesize\raggedright
% Representation: Qwen3-VL-8B bf16, no instruction, medium resolution, answerable
% MMLongBench-Doc questions with gold pages, accuracy (\%) under the error-taxonomy judge.
% Text, Vis. and Tokens are input tokens per page fed, so a retrieval depth of $k$ costs $k$
% times the row. Prefill and Decode are seconds per question
% (a mean of 1.9 gold pages) on two 16\,GB V100 GPUs, over the cells every
% representation ran there, which leaves out the cells that ran out of memory. TV pairs
% embedded text with the page image and needs no parser; it was not run on a V100, so it has
% no latency. Retrievers: page recall (\%) at depths 1, 5 and 10 over the 3{,}164 answerable
% questions of MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL together. BM25, BGE-M3 and Qwen3-Embedding-4B
% rank parser text on MMLongBench-Doc and the embedded text layer on LongDocURL; the three
% below them rank the page image. Idx. is seconds to index one page, Qry. the median
% milliseconds to rank a document's pages for one question, and GB the peak GPU memory, all
% on one 16\,GB V100 over 40 MMLongBench-Doc documents; BM25 runs on the CPU, and its
% indexing time includes reading the page text, which the others' does not. Reasoner: accuracy (\%) on the same
% questions at each representation, scored by the accuracy judge, so these levels sit about
% two to three points above the representation section's. GB is the weight footprint, with
% $^{\sim}$ marking one derived from the bf16 weights. Time is mean seconds per question
% at TLV on V100 GPUs, over the questions every configuration finished; the 4-bit
% Qwen3-VL-32B is timed on a sample of 80 of them. With no instruction a model answers at its own length,
% so Time also reflects how much it writes.\par}
